code='''def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    hr = next((r for r, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    vc = next((c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    sep = g[hr][0] if hr is not None else g[0][vc]
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v != sep)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rparts = [(0, hr), (hr+1, h)] if hr is not None else [(0,h)]
    cparts = [(0, vc), (vc+1,w)] if vc is not None else [(0,w)]
    best = max(((sum(g[r][c] != bg for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)),a,b,x,y) for a,b in rparts for x,y in cparts), key=lambda z:z[0])
    _, a,b,x,y = best
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for ra,rb in rparts:
        for ca,cb in cparts:
            for i in range(ra,rb):
                for j in range(ca,cb):
                    out[i][j] = g[a+(i-ra)%(b-a)][x+(j-ca)%(y-x)]
    if hr is not None:
        out[hr] = [sep]*w
    if vc is not None:
        for i in range(h): out[i][vc] = sep
    return out
'''
